clock_alignment.method: Vendor local timestamps use the captured explicit guest timezone. Every physical sample must remain inside the subtest for ALL offsets in the complete observed request/response bracket union plus1s vendor-boundary exclusion. Offset center is only a coordinate origin, not a constant-clock claim. Final cohort comparisons require the same maximum margin across all four clean boots; broader uncertainty removes more data. VFIO physical and guest memory share guest epoch. Between observed brackets, stock guest clock continuity remains a measurement assumption; harness makes no clock changes.
